log: |rule|Species Clause: Limit one of each Pokémon

decisions.thought: Rotom-Wash provides the best flexible lead with its Scarf speed, strong Hydro Pump pressure, and burn utility. Garchomp and Primarina round out the trio to pressure opposing Steel-types and cover the Dragons.

Their team is weak to Ground and Dragon. Garchomp leads with Sash to safely get Stealth Rock up, which pressures Dragonite and their Garchomp. Gholdengo blocks status and covers Fairy/Water, Kingambit cleans late.

Garchomp outspeeds Rotom-Wash and Earthquake hits it hard, likely scoring an early KO or heavy damage. Setting rocks is also fine, but taking the free turn to attack is better since Rotom can't be KO'd by rocks alone. Earthquake is the best play.

Rotom-Wash is locked into a poor matchup against Ground-type Garchomp, which is immune to Volt Switch and threatens it with Earthquake. Primarina is the safer switch and threatens Garchomp with Moonblast.
